speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the onset of the swelling and pain in your right ring finger, and has there been any recent injury or insect bite?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you hear or feel a "pop" at the time of injury, and are you currently unable to fully bend or straighten the tip of your finger? I also need to know if there is any visible deformity or if the finger looks crooked.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: This presentation of a "jumbo finger" deformity with an inability to actively flex the distal interphalangeal joint is highly suggestive of a Flexor Digitorum Profundus avulsion, commonly known as a "jersey finger." REQUEST TEST: Hand_X-Ray
